findings.summary: D18: T22 says empty reviews are ignored, but incrementalInputs retains them for rewrite detection, so an empty review on a rewritten-away commit can require a full-review request and prevent otherwise valid coverage.

D19: T20 promises skipping an earlier usable verdict, but the skip parser validates only identity and verdict while T21 also requires head and findings, so a malformed marker can suppress the model call without providing usable gate evidence.

D20: The stated skip safeguards require tests, but the supplied diff includes no behavioral tests for identity failure, comment-list failure, parser crashes, skip-comment posting failure, or marker generation across posting outcomes, leaving those safeguards unverified.
